evidence.exactSource: function progress(){const completed=new Set(S.history.filter(x=>x.kind==='check').map(x=>x.checkId));let count=C.checks.filter(x=>completed.has(x.id)).length;const percent=Math.round(count/C.checks.length*100);$('[data-progress-count]').textContent=`${count} of ${C.checks.length} checks`;$('[data-progress-percent]').textContent=percent+'%';$('[data-progress-fill]').style.width=percent+'%';$('[data-progress-fraction]').textContent=`${count} / ${C.checks.length}`;$$('[data-lesson-completion]').forEach(el=>{let check=C.checks.find(q=>q.route===el.dataset.lessonCompletion);el.textContent=completed.has(check?.id)?'Check completed':'Check not completed';});}

// Prevent opening answer models before the associated writing is valid.
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const summary=e.target.closest('summary');if(summary&&summary.parentElement.dataset.locked==='true'){e.preventDefault();status('Complete and save the required writing before comparing with this model.',true);}});

if(el.matches('[data-check-choice]')){const id=el.closest('[data-check-id]').dataset.checkId,run=S.checks[id],qid=el.dataset.checkChoice;if(!run||run.endedAt)return;change(n=>{n.checks[id].mc[qid].selected=el.value;});return;}
 if(el.matches('[data-check-writing]')){const id=el.closest('[data-check-id]').dataset.checkId,wid=el.dataset.checkWriting,run=S.checks[id];if(!run||run.endedAt)return;if(change(n=>{n.checks[id].writing[wid].draft=el.value;})){const node=el.closest('[data-writing-question]');$('[data-writing-status]',node).textContent=el.value.length>Number(el.dataset.limit)?'Oversized draft saved locally. Shorten before submission.':'Draft saved locally. Select Save written response to submit this version.';$('details',node).open=false;$('details',node).dataset.locked='true';}return;}

requiredMC.answerComparison: selected === q.answer; HTML input.value and JSON answer must match exactly.
requiredMC.laterIncorrect: Not correct yet. Answer: ${q.answer}. ${q.explanation} Select and check the correct answer to unlock the writing.
requiredMC.unlock: Every MC item must have a correct attempt; first-try scoring is independent from later correction.

writing.draft: Input persists draft, closes and locks the first details in that writing-question.
writing.save: Only after selections unlock writing; rejects blank trim or raw draft length above3200; records trimmed submitted text and timestamp.
writing.model: Native render unlocks the HTML details only when submitted is non-null and equals current draft.trim(). Model/criteria are existing static HTML, so revised text must be synchronized with JSON.
writing.completion: Requires every writing draft nonblank, length within limit, and submitted equal current trimmed draft; then pushes a completed check history record.
writing.grading: Writing saved and completed for human review; never automatically correctness-graded.

freshOriginRequirement.sourceReason: checkSpec prefers S.checks[id].spec; startCheck clones the current config spec into the new run. Prior saved runs can retain old question keys and models after same-ID semantic replacements.
freshOriginRequirement.authorizedMitigation: User requires a fresh versioned isolated origin with no migration of old saved state. This source review does not create that origin or run the tests.

preservation: No JS, storage namespace, required progress or gate behavior is altered. Optional note interfaces remain separate and do not use the required model lock.
testStatus: Static source read only. Correct/incorrect feedback, save/reload, unlock, completion, All My Work and failure paths require later browser testing.
